en.short_title: Your Stop Triggered. Why Is the Position Still Open?
en.desktop_description: A triggered order, an execution price, and a completed fill are different things. This brief explains market and limit orders, IOC versus FOK, stop-market versus stop-limit, TWAP/VWAP pacing, and exchange-hosted versus locally managed linked orders. Neither stop type guarantees a completed exit. Prices and quantities shown in examples are illustrative.
en.short_description: A stop condition activates an order. It does not guarantee a completed exit. See how liquidity, limit prices, and venue rules affect the outcome, then check trigger, price, partial fills, time in force, venue support, and strategy-process dependence.
